# FlowForm - Complete Endpoint & AI Agent Documentation

<!-- source: docs/guide/ai-agents.md -->

# AI Coding Agents Quickstart

A deterministic guide for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, v0, Lovable, Bolt) adding a form or reading submissions from a FlowForm instance.

---

## Add a Contact Form in 3 Steps

### 1. Create an Endpoint Form

Create an **Endpoint** form (`type: "endpoint"`) in the FlowForm admin panel or programmatically via the `create_form` MCP tool.

- **Redirect handling:** Never pass a relative path (like `/thank-you`) in `_next` because relative paths resolve on the FlowForm host, not your app. Instead, set **Redirect URL** in the FlowForm form settings, or pass an absolute `_next` URL whose domain is listed in the form's **Allowed Domains** (or `FLOWFORM_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_HOSTS`).
- **Mail notifications (optional):** Self-hosted deployments use the instance's configured SMTP provider in Admin Panel -> Mail Settings.

### 2. Copy the Form Slug

Record the FlowForm base URL (for example `https://forms.example.com` or `http://localhost:8000`) and the form `slug` (for example `contact-us`). Both `POST /f/{slug}` and `POST /api/v1/f/{slug}` also accept the form `access_key` or `uuid`.

### 3. Paste the Form Snippet

Use a standard HTML form when the browser navigates on submit, or JSON `fetch` when submitting inline without a page reload. Include the hidden `_gotcha` honeypot input in every form.

#### Option A: Zero-JS HTML Form (`POST /f/{slug}`)

```html
<form action="https://forms.example.com/f/contact-us" method="POST">
  <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" aria-hidden="true" />

  <label for="name">Name</label>
  <input id="name" type="text" name="name" required />

  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" type="email" name="email" required />

  <label for="message">Message</label>
  <textarea id="message" name="message" required></textarea>

  <button type="submit">Send Message</button>
</form>
```

For Astro, Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Hugo/Eleventy/Jekyll, or server/mobile clients, see the stack-specific guides:
- [Endpoints Overview](/guide/endpoints/)
- [HTML Forms](/guide/endpoints/html)
- [JavaScript (fetch & FormData)](/guide/endpoints/javascript)
- [Next.js](/guide/endpoints/nextjs)
- [Astro](/guide/endpoints/astro)
- [Nuxt](/guide/endpoints/nuxt)
- [SvelteKit](/guide/endpoints/sveltekit)
- [Static Site Generators](/guide/endpoints/static-site-generators)
- [Mobile & Server Clients](/guide/endpoints/mobile-and-servers)

#### Option B: Browser JavaScript (`POST /api/v1/f/{slug}`)

```html
<form id="contact-form">
  <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" aria-hidden="true" />
  <input type="text" name="name" required placeholder="Your name" />
  <input type="email" name="email" required placeholder="you@example.com" />
  <textarea name="message" required placeholder="How can we help?"></textarea>
  <button type="submit">Send</button>
  <p id="form-status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</form>

<script>
  const form = document.getElementById('contact-form');
  const statusEl = document.getElementById('form-status');

  form.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const payload = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form).entries());

    const response = await fetch('https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/contact-us', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Accept': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });

    const result = await response.json();
    if (response.ok && result.success) {
      statusEl.textContent = 'Message sent.';
      form.reset();
    } else {
      statusEl.textContent = result.error || 'Submission failed.';
    }
  });
</script>
```

---

## Exact Response Contract

- `POST /f/{slug}` accepts `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, `multipart/form-data`, or JSON. When `Accept: application/json` is absent and the form has a **Redirect URL** (or a valid `_next` / `_redirect`), it responds with `302 Found`. Otherwise it returns `200 OK` JSON.
- `POST /api/v1/f/{slug}` always responds with JSON and never redirects.

### Success (`200 OK`)

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Submission received",
  "id": "22c7a46f-fca5-4ad8-8348-14ccd6fd7cb0"
}
```

When `_gotcha` or `_honeypot` is non-empty, FlowForm discards the submission and returns `200 OK` with `"id": null`.

### Errors

| Status | Cause | Body |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `403` | `Origin` / `Referer` not in `allowed_domains`, or missing/invalid endpoint secret (`X-FlowForm-Secret` / `?_secret=`) | `{"success": false, "error": "Submissions are not permitted from this domain origin."}` |
| `404` | Form slug not found, form is inactive, or form is not in `endpoint` mode | `{"success": false, "error": "Form endpoint not found or inactive."}` |
| `422` | Missing/invalid captcha token (`cf-turnstile-response` / `h-captcha-response`), or uploaded file violates size/MIME rules | `{"success": false, "error": "...", "errors": {...}}` |
| `429` | Per-IP rate limit (`10` req/min/IP) or owner monthly quota exceeded | `{"success": false, "error": "..."}` or standard throttle JSON |

---

## Honeypot & Reserved Control Fields

FlowForm strips these reserved fields from saved submission data:

- `_gotcha`, `_honeypot`: Silent anti-spam trap. Keep hidden and empty for real users.
- `_next`, `_redirect`: Optional redirect target for `POST /f/{slug}`. Must be an absolute URL matching `APP_URL`, the form's **Allowed Domains**, or `FLOWFORM_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_HOSTS`.
- `_replyto`: Preserved as a standard field when submitted unless reserved by mailer configuration; note `_token`, `_method`, `_secret`, `_source`, `cf-turnstile-response`, `_turnstile`, `g-recaptcha-response`, `h-captcha-response`, and `_hcaptcha` are stripped automatically.
- File uploads (`<input type="file" name="attachment" />` with `enctype="multipart/form-data"`) are supported directly on endpoint forms.

---

## Connecting via MCP (`POST /api/v1/mcp`)

FlowForm exposes a JSON-RPC 2.0 Model Context Protocol endpoint at `POST /api/v1/mcp`. Authentication via a Laravel Sanctum bearer token is required. Create a scoped token in **Admin Panel -> API Tokens** or via Artisan (`php artisan token:create`).

### Required Token Abilities & Tools

| Tool Name | Required Ability | Arguments | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `list_forms` | `forms:read` | `limit` (integer, optional, default `20`, max `50`) | List active FlowForm endpoints and wizards visible to the user |
| `get_form_schema` | `forms:read` | `identifier` (string, required: UUID or slug) | Fetch steps, fields, options, captcha settings, and conditions |
| `create_form` | `forms:write` | `name` (string, required), `slug` (string), `type` (`"endpoint"` \| `"wizard"`), `is_encrypted` (boolean), `webhook_url` (string), `steps` (string[]) | Create a new endpoint or multi-step form |
| `submit_form` | `submissions:write` | `form_slug` (string, required), `data` (object, required) | Store a submission payload and dispatch webhooks |
| `list_submissions` | `submissions:read` | `form_slug` (string, required), `limit` (integer, optional, default `10`, max `30`) | List recent submissions for a form |

### Example MCP Calls

Initialize and list available tools:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/mcp \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}'
```

Create an endpoint form via MCP:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/mcp \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "id": 2,
    "method": "tools/call",
    "params": {
      "name": "create_form",
      "arguments": {
        "name": "Contact Us",
        "slug": "contact-us",
        "type": "endpoint"
      }
    }
  }'
```

Inspect available forms via MCP:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/mcp \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "id": 3,
    "method": "tools/call",
    "params": {
      "name": "list_forms",
      "arguments": {"limit": 20}
    }
  }'
```

You can also inspect the full AI-readable reference bundle at [/llms.txt](/llms.txt) and [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt).

---

<!-- source: docs/guide/endpoints/index.md -->

# Submit From Any Stack

FlowForm lets any website, app, or server send form submissions to a single hosted or self-hosted endpoint without building your own backend.

Create an **Endpoint** form in the FlowForm admin panel, copy its `slug` or `access_key`, and point your form or HTTP client to it.

---

## Endpoint URLs

Every active Endpoint form exposes two routes. Both accept your form's `slug`, `access_key`, or `uuid`:

| Route | Intended Caller | Default Success Response |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `POST https://forms.example.com/f/{slug}` | HTML `<form action="...">` | `302 Redirect` to `_next` / `redirect_url` (or `200 JSON` if none set) |
| `POST https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/{slug}` | JavaScript `fetch`, mobile apps, server-to-server | `200 JSON` (`{ "success": true, "message": "Submission received", "id": "<uuid>" }`) |

If you send `Accept: application/json` to `/f/{slug}`, FlowForm also returns JSON instead of redirecting.

---

## Reserved Fields

FlowForm strips reserved control fields before saving submission data so they never clutter your inbox or database:

| Field | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- |
| `_gotcha`, `_honeypot` | Anti-spam honeypot. If either field is non-empty, FlowForm returns a normal success response without saving the submission or sending notifications. |
| `_next`, `_redirect` | Redirect target after an HTML `<form>` submission. Use an absolute URL whose host matches the FlowForm instance's `APP_URL` or is listed in `FLOWFORM_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_HOSTS`. A relative path such as `/thank-you` redirects to that path **on the FlowForm host**, not on your site. For most sites, set **Redirect URL** in the form settings instead. |
| `_token`, `_method` | Stripped automatically so CSRF tokens or HTTP method spoofing fields from frameworks do not leak into submission payloads. |

---

## Minimal Example

```html
<form action="https://forms.example.com/f/contact-us" method="POST">
  <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" />

  <label for="name">Name</label>
  <input id="name" type="text" name="name" required />

  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" type="email" name="email" required />

  <label for="message">Message</label>
  <textarea id="message" name="message" required></textarea>

  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
```

---

## Response Codes & Error Handling

When returning JSON, FlowForm responds with predictable status codes:

```json
// 200 OK
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Submission received",
  "id": "22c7a46f-fca5-4ad8-8348-14ccd6fd7cb0"
}
```

| Status | Meaning | Response Body |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `200` | Submission saved (or honeypot triggered) | `{"success": true, "message": "Submission received", "id": "<uuid>"}` |
| `403` | Request `Origin` or `Referer` is not in `allowed_domains` | `{"success": false, "error": "Submissions are not permitted from this domain origin."}` |
| `404` | Form does not exist, is inactive, or is not in `endpoint` mode | `{"success": false, "error": "Form endpoint not found or inactive."}` |
| `422` | Validation failure on submitted payload | `{"success": false, "error": "..."}` |
| `429` | Rate limit (`10` requests/min/IP) or owner quota exceeded | `{"success": false, "error": "..."}` (or standard rate-limiter JSON) |

---

## Spam Basics (Honeypot)

Include a hidden `_gotcha` (or `_honeypot`) input in browser forms and JSON payloads. Bots that auto-fill every field trigger the trap and are silently discarded while returning `200 OK`:

```html
<input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" aria-hidden="true" />
```

When posting JSON from JavaScript or a framework action, send `_gotcha` along with your form fields:

```json
{
  "name": "Alice",
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "_gotcha": ""
}
```

---

## CORS & Allowed Domains

FlowForm sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, `Access-Control-Allow-Methods: POST, OPTIONS`, and `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type, Accept, X-Requested-With` on endpoint responses so browser `fetch()` calls work from any origin without preflight issues.

To lock a form down to your own websites, set **Allowed Domains** (`allowed_domains`) on the form (comma-separated, wildcards supported):

```text
example.com, *.example.com
```

FlowForm checks the request's `Origin` header (falling back to `Referer`). If the domain does not match, FlowForm rejects the submission with `403 Forbidden`. Requests with no `Origin` or `Referer` header (such as `curl` or server-to-server actions) pass the browser origin check.

---

## Choose Your Stack

- [HTML Forms](/guide/endpoints/html) - Zero-JS HTML `<form>` with honeypot and `_next` redirect
- [JavaScript (fetch & FormData)](/guide/endpoints/javascript) - Vanilla browser JS with JSON and `FormData`
- [Next.js](/guide/endpoints/nextjs) - App Router Server Actions and Client Components
- [Astro](/guide/endpoints/astro) - Static `<form>` and Astro Actions
- [Nuxt](/guide/endpoints/nuxt) - Vue `$fetch` component submission
- [SvelteKit](/guide/endpoints/sveltekit) - Server-side form actions with progressive enhancement
- [Static Site Generators](/guide/endpoints/static-site-generators) - Hugo, Eleventy, and Jekyll partials
- [Mobile & Server Clients](/guide/endpoints/mobile-and-servers) - curl, React Native, Flutter, Python, and PHP/Laravel

---

## Troubleshooting

- **403 Forbidden (Origin not allowed):** Your `Origin` or `Referer` header does not match the form's `allowed_domains`. Add your domain (including `localhost` during local development) or leave `allowed_domains` blank to allow all origins.
- **429 Too Many Requests:** Public endpoints enforce a `10` requests-per-minute-per-IP rate limit (`endpoint-submissions`). Wait 60 seconds before retrying, or avoid rapid automated test bursts from a single IP.
- **CORS preflight errors in browser dev tools:** Ensure you post to `/api/v1/f/{slug}` or `/f/{slug}` and only send standard headers (`Content-Type`, `Accept`, `X-Requested-With`).
- **`_next` redirect ignored (returns JSON instead):** FlowForm only redirects `_next` to the instance's own host or to hosts in `FLOWFORM_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_HOSTS` (`localhost,127.0.0.1` by default). Set **Redirect URL** on the form instead (no server config needed), or, on a self-hosted instance, add your domain to `FLOWFORM_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_HOSTS`.
- **Redirected to a 404 on the FlowForm domain:** a relative `_next` like `/thank-you` resolves against the FlowForm host. Use **Redirect URL** with your full thank-you page URL.

---

<!-- source: docs/guide/endpoints/html.md -->

# Plain HTML Form

Point any standard HTML `<form>` directly to FlowForm with zero JavaScript. FlowForm stores the submission, sends notifications and, if you set a Redirect URL on the form, sends your visitor to your thank-you page.

---

## Minimal Snippet

```html
<form action="https://forms.example.com/f/contact-us" method="POST">
  <!-- Honeypot spam trap: keep hidden from human visitors -->
  <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" aria-hidden="true" />


  <div>
    <label for="name">Name</label>
    <input id="name" type="text" name="name" required />
  </div>

  <div>
    <label for="email">Email</label>
    <input id="email" type="email" name="email" required />
  </div>

  <div>
    <label for="message">Message</label>
    <textarea id="message" name="message" rows="4" required></textarea>
  </div>

  <button type="submit">Send Message</button>
</form>
```

---

## Honeypot Field

The `_gotcha` input sits off-screen (`style="display:none"`) with `tabindex="-1"` and `autocomplete="off"` so keyboard navigation and password managers skip it. If a bot fills it out, FlowForm treats the request as spam, discards the payload, and redirects or responds as if it succeeded.

---

## Success & Error Handling

### Redirects (`_next` vs. Form Settings)

1. **Recommended:** set **Redirect URL** in the form settings to your full thank-you page (for example `https://example.com/thank-you`). FlowForm responds with `302 Found` to it after every successful submission.
2. Per-page override: add `<input type="hidden" name="_next" value="https://example.com/thank-you" />`. FlowForm only follows `_next` when its host is the instance's own host or is listed in `FLOWFORM_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_HOSTS` (self-hosted setting); otherwise it falls back to the Redirect URL. Don't use a relative path: `/thank-you` redirects to that path on the FlowForm host, not on your site.
3. If neither is set, FlowForm returns `200 OK` with JSON:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Submission received",
  "id": "22c7a46f-fca5-4ad8-8348-14ccd6fd7cb0"
}
```

### Handling Errors

In plain HTML submissions, errors (`403`, `404`, `429`) render JSON responses from the FlowForm endpoint. If you want inline error banners without leaving your page, enhance the form with [vanilla JavaScript `fetch`](/guide/endpoints/javascript).

---

## Troubleshooting

- **403 Forbidden (Origin not allowed):** Browsers send a `Referer` header on native `<form>` submits. If `allowed_domains` is set on the form, include the exact domain serving the HTML page (or `localhost` when testing locally).
- **429 Too Many Requests:** Rapidly submitting a test form more than `10` times per minute from the same IP triggers FlowForm's rate limiter.
- **CORS & Redirects:** Native HTML `<form>` submits are normal browser navigations and are not blocked by CORS. For redirects, use the form's **Redirect URL** setting; `_next` to your own domain only works if that host is in `FLOWFORM_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_HOSTS` on the FlowForm instance.

---

<!-- source: docs/guide/endpoints/javascript.md -->

# Vanilla JavaScript (`fetch` & `FormData`)

Submit forms asynchronously without a page reload using the browser's built-in `fetch()` API. Post to `/api/v1/f/{slug}` to guarantee a JSON response even if the form has a default redirect URL.

---

## Option 1 · JSON Payload (`fetch`)

```html
<form id="contact-form">
  <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" />

  <label for="name">Name</label>
  <input id="name" type="text" name="name" required />

  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" type="email" name="email" required />

  <label for="message">Message</label>
  <textarea id="message" name="message" required></textarea>

  <button type="submit">Send</button>
  <p id="form-status" role="status"></p>
</form>

<script>
  const form = document.getElementById('contact-form');
  const status = document.getElementById('form-status');

  form.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    status.textContent = 'Sending...';

    const payload = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form).entries());

    try {
      const response = await fetch('https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/contact-us', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Accept': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      const result = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        status.textContent = result.error || 'Submission failed. Please try again.';
        return;
      }

      form.reset();
      status.textContent = `Thanks! Reference ID: ${result.id}`;
    } catch (error) {
      status.textContent = 'Network error. Please check your connection.';
    }
  });
</script>
```

---

## Option 2 · `FormData` Payload

If you prefer sending `multipart/form-data` directly from a `FormData` instance, omit the `Content-Type` header so the browser attaches the boundary automatically:

```javascript
const form = document.getElementById('contact-form');

form.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();

  const response = await fetch('https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/contact-us', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Accept': 'application/json',
    },
    body: new FormData(form),
  });

  const result = await response.json();
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(result.error || 'Submission failed');
  }

  console.log('Saved submission:', result.id);
});
```

---

## Honeypot Field

Both examples read `_gotcha` automatically through `new FormData(form)`. Bots that populate hidden inputs send a non-empty `_gotcha` value, causing FlowForm to return `200 OK` without storing spam.

---

## Success & Error Handling

Check `response.ok` before reading `result.id`:

- **`200 OK`:** `{ "success": true, "message": "Submission received", "id": "<uuid>" }`.
- **`403` / `404` / `422` / `429`:** `response.ok` is `false`. Display `result.error` to the user, or fall back to a generic message if a `429` rate limit returns `{ "message": "Too Many Attempts." }`.

---

## Troubleshooting

- **403 Forbidden (Origin not allowed):** Browsers automatically send the `Origin` header on `fetch()`. Verify that the page's origin is listed in the form's `allowed_domains`.
- **429 Too Many Requests:** Each IP is limited to `10` endpoint submissions per minute. Disable the submit button while the request is in flight to avoid accidental double submits.
- **CORS errors:** Do not set `credentials: 'include'` (FlowForm's endpoint wildcard CORS header is configured for stateless submissions with `supports_credentials: false`), and never manually set `Content-Type: multipart/form-data` when passing a `FormData` body.

---

<!-- source: docs/guide/endpoints/nextjs.md -->

# Next.js (App Router)

Use a Next.js App Router **Server Action** to forward submissions from your server, or a **Client Component** to submit directly from the browser.

---

## Option 1 · Server Action (Recommended)

Posting from a Server Action keeps your FlowForm endpoint URL out of client bundles and works with progressive enhancement:

```tsx
// app/contact/actions.ts
'use server';

export interface FormState {
  status: 'idle' | 'success' | 'error';
  message: string;
}

export async function submitContact(
  _prevState: FormState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<FormState> {
  const endpoint = process.env.FLOWFORM_ENDPOINT_URL!;

  const payload = {
    name: String(formData.get('name') ?? ''),
    email: String(formData.get('email') ?? ''),
    message: String(formData.get('message') ?? ''),
    _gotcha: String(formData.get('_gotcha') ?? ''),
  };

  try {
    const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Accept': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });

    const data = await response.json();

    if (!response.ok) {
      return {
        status: 'error',
        message: data.error || 'Could not submit your message.',
      };
    }

    return {
      status: 'success',
      message: `Received! Reference ID: ${data.id}`,
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      status: 'error',
      message: 'Unable to reach form service. Please try again.',
    };
  }
}
```

```tsx
// app/contact/page.tsx
'use client';

import { useActionState } from 'react';
import { submitContact, type FormState } from './actions';

const initialState: FormState = { status: 'idle', message: '' };

export default function ContactPage() {
  const [state, formAction, isPending] = useActionState(submitContact, initialState);

  return (
    <form action={formAction}>
      <input
        type="text"
        name="_gotcha"
        style={{ display: 'none' }}
        tabIndex={-1}
        autoComplete="off"
      />

      <input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Name" required />
      <input type="email" name="email" placeholder="Email" required />
      <textarea name="message" placeholder="Message" required />

      <button type="submit" disabled={isPending}>
        {isPending ? 'Sending...' : 'Send'}
      </button>

      {state.message && <p role="status">{state.message}</p>}
    </form>
  );
}
```

Set `FLOWFORM_ENDPOINT_URL=https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/contact-us` in `.env.local`.

---

## Option 2 · Client Component

If your Next.js app uses static export (`output: 'export'`), submit directly from a Client Component:

```tsx
// app/contact/ContactForm.tsx
'use client';

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';

export function ContactForm() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<string>('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setStatus('');

    const form = event.currentTarget;
    const payload = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form).entries());

    try {
      const res = await fetch('https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/contact-us', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Accept': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        setStatus(data.error || 'Submission failed.');
        return;
      }

      form.reset();
      setStatus(`Thanks! Reference ID: ${data.id}`);
    } catch {
      setStatus('Network error. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style={{ display: 'none' }} tabIndex={-1} autoComplete="off" />
      <input type="text" name="name" required />
      <input type="email" name="email" required />
      <textarea name="message" required />
      <button type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
        {submitting ? 'Sending...' : 'Send'}
      </button>
      {status && <p>{status}</p>}
    </form>
  );
}
```

---

## Honeypot Field

Both approaches send `_gotcha`. FlowForm strips `_gotcha` from saved submissions and silently ignores requests where `_gotcha` is non-empty.

---

## Success & Error Handling

- Check `response.ok` (HTTP `200`). Read `data.id` for the created submission UUID.
- On error (`403`, `404`, `422`, `429`), read `data.error` (or fall back to a generic message if the rate limiter returns `429` without `.error`).

---

## Troubleshooting

- **403 Forbidden (Origin not allowed):** In Client Component mode, add your Next.js domain (and `localhost` for local dev) to `allowed_domains`. Server Actions do not send a browser `Origin` header by default, so they pass `allowed_domains` automatically.
- **429 Too Many Requests:** Server Actions share your Next.js server's outbound IP, so all users submitting through the Server Action share the `10` requests/min/IP limit. For high-traffic sites using Server Actions, prefer direct browser submits in a Client Component so each visitor's IP is rated independently.
- **CORS errors:** Only relevant in Client Components. Ensure you submit to `/api/v1/f/{slug}` with `Content-Type: application/json` and `Accept: application/json` without credentials cookies.

---

<!-- source: docs/guide/endpoints/astro.md -->

# Astro

Connect an Astro site to FlowForm with a zero-JS HTML `<form>` on static pages, or use an **Astro Action** when running with SSR.

---

## Option 1 · Static HTML Form

For static Astro sites (`output: 'static'`), render a plain `<form>` inside any `.astro` page:

```astro
---
// src/pages/contact.astro
---
<form action="https://forms.example.com/f/contact-us" method="POST">
  <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" />

  <label>
    Name
    <input type="text" name="name" required />
  </label>

  <label>
    Email
    <input type="email" name="email" required />
  </label>

  <label>
    Message
    <textarea name="message" required></textarea>
  </label>

  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
```

---

## Option 2 · Astro Action (SSR)

If you use Astro Actions (`src/actions/index.ts`) for typed validation before forwarding to FlowForm:

```typescript
// src/actions/index.ts
import { ActionError, defineAction } from 'astro:actions';
import { z } from 'astro:schema';

export const server = {
  contact: defineAction({
    accept: 'form',
    input: z.object({
      name: z.string().min(1),
      email: z.string().email(),
      message: z.string().min(1),
      _gotcha: z.string().optional(),
    }),
    handler: async (input) => {
      const response = await fetch('https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/contact-us', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Accept': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(input),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new ActionError({
          code: response.status === 429 ? 'TOO_MANY_REQUESTS' : 'BAD_REQUEST',
          message: data.error || 'Submission failed.',
        });
      }

      return { id: data.id };
    },
  }),
};
```

```astro
---
// src/pages/contact.astro
import { actions } from 'astro:actions';
---
<form method="POST" action={actions.contact}>
  <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" />
  <input type="text" name="name" required />
  <input type="email" name="email" required />
  <textarea name="message" required></textarea>
  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
```

---

## Honeypot Field

The `_gotcha` field is included in both the static HTML `<form>` and the Astro Action `z.object` schema so FlowForm drops automated spam payloads on arrival.

---

## Success & Error Handling

- **Static `<form>`:** Redirects (`302 Found`) to the form's **Redirect URL** if one is set; otherwise returns JSON.
- **Astro Action:** Throws `ActionError` when `!response.ok` and returns `{ id }` on `200 OK`.

---

## Troubleshooting

- **403 Forbidden (Origin not allowed):** Add your Astro site's domain to `allowed_domains` in FlowForm form settings when using client-side `<form>` submits.
- **429 Too Many Requests:** Public endpoints enforce `10` requests per minute per IP. With SSR Astro Actions, server-side requests share your server's IP.
- **CORS / Redirect issues:** Set **Redirect URL** on the form to your Astro thank-you page. A relative `_next` such as `/thank-you` redirects to the FlowForm host, not your site; `_next` with a full URL needs your domain in `FLOWFORM_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_HOSTS` on the FlowForm server.

---

<!-- source: docs/guide/endpoints/nuxt.md -->

# Nuxt

Send form submissions from any Nuxt 3 page or component using `$fetch` with reactive loading, success, and error state.

---

## Minimal Snippet

```vue
<!-- components/ContactForm.vue -->
<script setup lang="ts">
const form = reactive({
  name: '',
  email: '',
  message: '',
  _gotcha: '',
});

const pending = ref(false);
const submissionId = ref<string | null>(null);
const errorMessage = ref<string | null>(null);

async function submit() {
  pending.value = true;
  errorMessage.value = null;

  try {
    const response = await $fetch<{ success: boolean; message: string; id: string }>(
      'https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/contact-us',
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Accept': 'application/json',
        },
        body: { ...form },
      },
    );

    submissionId.value = response.id;
    form.name = '';
    form.email = '';
    form.message = '';
  } catch (err: any) {
    errorMessage.value =
      err?.data?.error || 'Submission failed. Please try again.';
  } finally {
    pending.value = false;
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <form @submit.prevent="submit">
    <!-- Honeypot field -->
    <input
      v-model="form._gotcha"
      type="text"
      name="_gotcha"
      style="display:none"
      tabindex="-1"
      autocomplete="off"
    />

    <div>
      <label for="name">Name</label>
      <input id="name" v-model="form.name" type="text" required />
    </div>

    <div>
      <label for="email">Email</label>
      <input id="email" v-model="form.email" type="email" required />
    </div>

    <div>
      <label for="message">Message</label>
      <textarea id="message" v-model="form.message" required />
    </div>

    <button type="submit" :disabled="pending">
      {{ pending ? 'Sending...' : 'Send Message' }}
    </button>

    <p v-if="submissionId" role="status">
      Thanks! Reference ID: {{ submissionId }}
    </p>
    <p v-if="errorMessage" role="alert">
      {{ errorMessage }}
    </p>
  </form>
</template>
```

---

## Honeypot Field

Binding `_gotcha` to `v-model="form._gotcha"` keeps the input hidden in the DOM while forwarding it in the JSON body. If a bot fills it out, FlowForm silently discards the submission and returns `200 OK`.

---

## Success & Error Handling

`$fetch` automatically parses JSON bodies and throws a `FetchError` on non-2xx responses:

- **Success (`200 OK`):** `response.id` contains the created submission UUID.
- **Error (`403`, `404`, `422`, `429`):** Read `err?.data?.error` inside `catch` and display it in `errorMessage`.

---

## Troubleshooting

- **403 Forbidden (Origin not allowed):** Add your Nuxt domain (plus `localhost` for local testing) to `allowed_domains` on the FlowForm form.
- **429 Too Many Requests:** Each client IP is capped at `10` requests per minute. Keep `:disabled="pending"` on the submit button to prevent double submits.
- **CORS errors:** `$fetch` posts JSON directly without cookies by default. Do not add `credentials: 'include'` because FlowForm's public endpoints are stateless.

---

<!-- source: docs/guide/endpoints/sveltekit.md -->

# SvelteKit

Use a SvelteKit **Form Action** (`+page.server.ts`) to forward form data from the server, paired with `use:enhance` on `+page.svelte` for progressive enhancement without full page reloads.

---

## Minimal Snippet

### 1. Server Form Action (`src/routes/contact/+page.server.ts`)

```typescript
import { fail } from '@sveltejs/kit';
import type { Actions } from './$types';

export const actions = {
  default: async ({ request, fetch }) => {
    const formData = await request.formData();

    const payload = {
      name: String(formData.get('name') ?? ''),
      email: String(formData.get('email') ?? ''),
      message: String(formData.get('message') ?? ''),
      _gotcha: String(formData.get('_gotcha') ?? ''),
    };

    const response = await fetch('https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/contact-us', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Accept': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });

    const result = await response.json();

    if (!response.ok) {
      return fail(response.status, {
        error: result.error || 'Submission failed.',
        name: payload.name,
        email: payload.email,
      });
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      id: result.id,
    };
  },
} satisfies Actions;
```

### 2. Page Component (`src/routes/contact/+page.svelte`)

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { enhance } from '$app/forms';
  import type { ActionData } from './$types';

  export let form: ActionData;
</script>

<form method="POST" use:enhance>
  <!-- Honeypot spam trap -->
  <input
    type="text"
    name="_gotcha"
    style="display:none"
    tabindex="-1"
    autocomplete="off"
  />

  <label>
    Name
    <input type="text" name="name" value={form?.name ?? ''} required />
  </label>

  <label>
    Email
    <input type="email" name="email" value={form?.email ?? ''} required />
  </label>

  <label>
    Message
    <textarea name="message" required></textarea>
  </label>

  <button type="submit">Send Message</button>

  {#if form?.success}
    <p role="status">Thanks! Reference ID: {form.id}</p>
  {:else if form?.error}
    <p role="alert">{form.error}</p>
  {/if}
</form>
```

---

## Honeypot Field

The hidden `_gotcha` input is forwarded in `payload` to FlowForm. FlowForm strips `_gotcha` from saved data and discards any submission where `_gotcha` has a value.

---

## Success & Error Handling

- When FlowForm returns `200 OK`, the action returns `{ success: true, id: result.id }`.
- When FlowForm returns `403`, `404`, `422`, or `429`, `fail(response.status, { error })` preserves the HTTP error code and renders `form.error` without losing the visitor's entered name or email.

---

## Troubleshooting

- **403 Forbidden (Origin not allowed):** SvelteKit `+page.server.ts` actions run on your Node/edge server without a browser `Origin` header, so they bypass browser origin checks. If you switch to client-side `fetch()` on static routes (`@sveltejs/adapter-static`), add your site's domain to `allowed_domains`.
- **429 Too Many Requests:** Server-side actions share your SvelteKit server's IP against the `10` requests/min/IP limit. For high-volume forms, submit directly from `+page.svelte` to `/api/v1/f/{slug}` so each visitor uses their own IP quota.
- **CORS / CSRF errors:** SvelteKit blocks cross-origin browser POSTs to SvelteKit actions unless configured, whereas direct browser calls to FlowForm allow cross-origin `POST` via `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`.

---

<!-- source: docs/guide/endpoints/static-site-generators.md -->

# Static Site Generators (Hugo, Eleventy, Jekyll)

Static site generators compile templates into plain HTML files with no server runtime. Embed a standard HTML `<form>` partial pointing to your FlowForm `/f/{slug}` endpoint.

---

## Hugo

Create a reusable partial at `layouts/partials/contact-form.html`:

```html
<!-- layouts/partials/contact-form.html -->
<form action="{{ .Site.Params.flowformEndpoint }}" method="POST">
  <!-- Honeypot anti-spam trap -->
  <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" />

  <!-- Optional redirect after submit -->

  <label for="name">Name</label>
  <input id="name" type="text" name="name" required />

  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" type="email" name="email" required />

  <label for="message">Message</label>
  <textarea id="message" name="message" required></textarea>

  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
```

Set the endpoint in `hugo.toml`:

```toml
[params]
  flowformEndpoint = "https://forms.example.com/f/contact-us"
```

---

## Eleventy (11ty)

Create a Nunjucks include at `_includes/contact-form.njk`:

```html
<!-- _includes/contact-form.njk -->
<form action="{{ site.flowformEndpoint }}" method="POST">
  <!-- Honeypot anti-spam trap -->
  <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" />


  <label for="name">Name</label>
  <input id="name" type="text" name="name" required />

  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" type="email" name="email" required />

  <label for="message">Message</label>
  <textarea id="message" name="message" required></textarea>

  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
```

Define `flowformEndpoint` in `_data/site.json`:

```json
{
  "flowformEndpoint": "https://forms.example.com/f/contact-us"
}
```

---

## Jekyll

Create a Liquid include at `_includes/contact-form.html`:

```html
<!-- _includes/contact-form.html -->
<form action="{{ site.flowform_endpoint }}" method="POST">
  <!-- Honeypot anti-spam trap -->
  <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" />


  <label for="name">Name</label>
  <input id="name" type="text" name="name" required />

  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" type="email" name="email" required />

  <label for="message">Message</label>
  <textarea id="message" name="message" required></textarea>

  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
```

Define `flowform_endpoint` in `_config.yml`:

```yaml
flowform_endpoint: "https://forms.example.com/f/contact-us"
```

---

## Honeypot Field

Every partial includes `<input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" />`. FlowForm detects non-empty `_gotcha` values, drops the submission, and still honors the redirect so bots cannot tell they were blocked.

---

## Success & Error Handling

- **Redirect on success:** Configure **Redirect URL** in the FlowForm form settings with your full thank-you page URL. Don't use a relative `_next` (it resolves against the FlowForm host).
- **No-reload UX:** Add a small progressive script using [vanilla JavaScript `fetch`](/guide/endpoints/javascript) if you want inline confirmation instead of a redirect.

---

## Troubleshooting

- **403 Forbidden (Origin not allowed):** Add your published static site domain (such as `example.com`) to `allowed_domains` in FlowForm. Remember to include `localhost` if previewing with `hugo server`, `eleventy --serve`, or `jekyll serve`.
- **429 Too Many Requests:** Public endpoints allow `10` requests per minute per visitor IP.
- **CORS & Redirects:** Plain HTML form posts do not require CORS, but full external URLs in `_next` (such as `https://example.com/thank-you`) require `example.com` to be allowlisted in `FLOWFORM_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_HOSTS` on your FlowForm instance (or configured in the form's `redirect_url` setting).

---

<!-- source: docs/guide/endpoints/mobile-and-servers.md -->

# Mobile Apps & Server Clients

Send submissions directly from native mobile apps, CLI scripts, or backend workers using `/api/v1/f/{slug}`. No API authentication token is required for active Endpoint forms.

---

## curl

```bash
curl -X POST https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/contact-us \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Alice",
    "email": "alice@example.com",
    "message": "Hello from curl!",
    "_gotcha": ""
  }'
```

Success response (`200 OK`):

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Submission received",
  "id": "22c7a46f-fca5-4ad8-8348-14ccd6fd7cb0"
}
```

---

## React Native (`fetch`)

```typescript
export async function submitToFlowForm(payload: {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  message: string;
  _gotcha?: string;
}) {
  const response = await fetch('https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/contact-us', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Accept': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      _gotcha: '',
      ...payload,
    }),
  });

  const data = await response.json();

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(data.error || `Request failed with status ${response.status}`);
  }

  return data as { success: boolean; message: string; id: string };
}
```

---

## Flutter (`package:http`)

Add `http` to `pubspec.yaml` (`flutter pub add http`) and post JSON:

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

Future<String> submitToFlowForm({
  required String name,
  required String email,
  required String message,
  String honeypot = '',
}) async {
  final uri = Uri.parse('https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/contact-us');

  final response = await http.post(
    uri,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Accept': 'application/json',
    },
    body: jsonEncode({
      'name': name,
      'email': email,
      'message': message,
      '_gotcha': honeypot,
    }),
  );

  final body = jsonDecode(response.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;

  if (response.statusCode != 200) {
    throw Exception(body['error'] ?? 'Submission failed (${response.statusCode})');
  }

  return body['id'] as String;
}
```

---

## Python (`requests`)

```python
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/contact-us",
    headers={"Accept": "application/json"},
    json={
        "name": "Alice",
        "email": "alice@example.com",
        "message": "Hello from Python!",
        "_gotcha": "",
    },
    timeout=10,
)

data = response.json()
if not response.ok:
    raise RuntimeError(data.get("error", f"HTTP {response.status_code}"))

print("Submission ID:", data["id"])
```

---

## PHP (Laravel `Http::post`)

```php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;

$response = Http::acceptJson()
    ->timeout(10)
    ->post('https://forms.example.com/api/v1/f/contact-us', [
        'name' => 'Alice',
        'email' => 'alice@example.com',
        'message' => 'Hello from Laravel!',
        '_gotcha' => '',
    ]);

if ($response->failed()) {
    throw new \RuntimeException(
        $response->json('error') ?? 'Submission failed with status '.$response->status()
    );
}

$submissionId = $response->json('id');
```

---

## Honeypot Field

Include `"_gotcha": ""` (left empty for legitimate submissions) in every mobile or server payload. If populated, FlowForm drops the submission and returns `200 OK`.

---

## Success & Error Handling

Always check the HTTP status code before reading `id`:

- **`200`:** `{"success": true, "message": "Submission received", "id": "<uuid>"}`.
- **`403`:** Origin or `Referer` blocked by `allowed_domains`.
- **`404`:** Unknown slug/access key, inactive form, or form is in `wizard` mode instead of `endpoint` mode.
- **`429`:** Rate limit (`10` req/min/IP) or owner quota exhausted.

---

## Troubleshooting

- **403 Forbidden (Origin not allowed):** Native mobile apps and server HTTP clients typically omit `Origin` and `Referer`, which passes `allowed_domains`. If your client manually sets a `Referer` or `Origin` header, ensure that domain is in `allowed_domains`.
- **429 Too Many Requests:** Background batch jobs or shared backend proxies sending more than `10` requests per minute from a single IP will be throttled. Space out automated jobs or submit with backoff.
- **CORS:** Native mobile runtimes (React Native, Flutter) and server clients (`curl`, Python, PHP) do not enforce browser CORS policies. If running React Native Web or Flutter Web in a browser, use standard JSON headers without cookies.
